rows.title: The Penthouse Reunion
rows.description: Elena and David finally give in to the tension that has been building since their first encounter. A night in his Manhattan penthouse changes everything.
rows.excerpt: The elevator doors opened to reveal David's penthouse, and Elena felt her breath catch. Floor-to-ceiling windows showcased the glittering Manhattan skyline...

rows.title: Late Night at Chen Technologies
rows.description: Sarah stays late to finish the Redwood project, but she's not alone. Michael has been watching her all evening, and tonight, he can't hold back anymore.
rows.excerpt: The office was empty except for the soft glow of Sarah's computer screen. She didn't hear him approach until his voice came from the doorway...

rows.title: Three Years Later
rows.description: Sophia never expected to see Dominic again. But when she walks into Kane Industries for a job interview, the past comes rushing back—along with feelings she thought she'd buried.
rows.excerpt: Sophia's heart stopped when she saw him. Three years hadn't changed those storm-gray eyes, the ones that haunted her dreams...

rows.title: The Charity Gala
rows.description: At the Met's most exclusive event, Victoria and James find themselves drawn together despite knowing they shouldn't. What happens in the Temple of Dendur stays in the Temple of Dendur.
rows.excerpt: The champagne was flowing, the diamonds were sparkling, but Victoria only had eyes for one man across the crowded gallery...

rows.title: The Private Jet
rows.description: A business trip to Paris becomes something much more when Elena and David are alone at 40,000 feet. The mile-high club has never been so exclusive.
rows.excerpt: The Gulfstream leveled off above the clouds, and David dismissed the flight attendant. They had eight hours to Paris, and he intended to use every minute...
